label: Graviera Kritis
note: Cretan PDO, goat milk at most about 20 %. Naxos graviera (PDO) is mostly cow milk, Agrafa the third PDO graviera. The name comes from Gruyère.

about.text: Graviera is a Greek hard cheese made in wheels with the crisscross mark of its draining cloth, and is Greece's second most popular cheese after feta. Graviera of Crete is made from sheep milk and has a slightly sweet, burnt caramel flavour.
